# Flamerite Fires - llms.txt

> Flamerite Fires is a UK manufacturer of premium electric fires, media walls, and fireplace suites. We specialise in realistic flame technology including our E-FX and E-Ridium holographic fire ranges.

## About Flamerite Fires
Flamerite Fires designs and manufactures high-quality electric fires in the UK. Our products include built-in fires, fireplace suites, media walls, and hearth/inset fires featuring advanced flame effect technology.

## Product Ranges
- E-FX Built-In Fires: 1000mm, 1300mm, 1500mm, 1800mm widths
- E-Ridium Holographic Fires: Revolutionary 3D flame technology
- Fireplace Suites: Complete packages including Elara, Payton, Europa, Arcadia, Stanford, Willow
- Slim-Line Range: SL600, SL750S, SL750T, SL1000
- Compact Fires: Alto 16, Cera 16, Tama 16, Lando 22, Reid 22, Vento 22
